title: MCP Seriveri
allowPermissionsDesc: Iyo bishobotse, guhamagara ibikoresho MCP byose bizahita byemerwa nta kwerekana uruhushya. Igenamiterere rikoreshwa kwisi yose mubiganiro byose, harimo ibiganiro bishya.

runtimeSettings.title: Igenamiterere ryigihe
runtimeSettings.description: Hindura uburyo Novera icunga kandi igerageza seriveri MCP.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Igihe ntarengwa cyo gutegereza MCP igikoresho gisubiza mbere yigihe.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Ibisubizo birebire byabitswe mubiganiro. Ikintu cyose cyashize ibi byaragabanijwe kandi bigashyirwaho ikimenyetso, bityo igisubizo kinini ntigishobora kunaniza imiterere yicyitegererezo. Shyira kuri 0 kugirango ukomeze ibisubizo byose.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: Iyo ishoboye, Novera ihitamo seriveri MCP bijyanye mbere yo gupakira ibikoresho. Hagarika guhora wuzuza urutonde rwibikoresho MCP.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: Iyo inzira yubwenge iriho, koresha intambwe yo kugendana hamwe na moderi itandukanye (akenshi iba nto) aho kwerekana uburyo bwo kuganira. Zimya kugirango uhore ukoresha moderi ikora yo kuganira kugirango ikoreshwe.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Hitamo utanga nicyitegererezo ahantu hamwe. Gusa moderi yoroheje urutonde kuburyo inzira igumaho vuba kandi ihendutse.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Nta moderi yoroheje ihari. Ongeraho moderi ntoya cyangwa ugene API urufunguzo muri Model.

auth.needsAuthHint: Injira muri iyi seriveri kugirango uhuze.
